reviews.title: Suspicious Activity
reviews.text: When I tried opening the app, it wouldn’t leave from the home loading screen. It kept saying no internet or some other weird notification. I then received a notification that suspicious activity was being detected.

reviews.title: Server doesn’t work
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for over a year. I don’t use it every day, but for the past few days I’ve repeatedly been unable to connect. The app keeps telling me there’s no internet connection, even though my internet is working fine and every other app on my phone connects without any issues.

It’s frustrating, especially for a paid service. I’ve enjoyed using the app when it works, but reliability is important. If this continues, I’ll have to look for an alternative that’s more dependable. I hope this issue gets resolved soon.

reviews.title: Used to Live this App
reviews.text: It seems every update more capability is removed and more hugs are added. I cannot even open it anymore. Even with a removal and reinstall on my device. I guess it’s its time to find a better option.

reviews.title: app isn’t working for days
reviews.text: i have been using this app for 2 plus years and now error on connection, and i am connected to network. unfortunately if it is not fixed i will have to cancel my subscription

reviews.title: Server Issues ??? I call B/S!
reviews.text:
Latest up date is causing my app to get “failure to connect to server”.  Rendering my paid app useless.

It’s Apps like this  that pull stunts like this that make people reluctant to invest into any app.   My guess is that y’all have not paid your web provider & have lost access to the server…. The messages we all are receiving is revealing your lack of service to keep up with your own responsibilities.  

No one has connection to this app because this app isn’t connected to a domain. The developer shouldn’t be allowed to continuously get new users if this issue isn’t resolved.  06-11-2026

reviews.title: Pay to play is a loser model
reviews.text: Honestly just make it accessible. Don’t take information and then demand the user pay. You’re already leeching information.

reviews.title: Terrible app & CS response
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app and it’s not intuitive to use, it’s missing useful information, and it gets profiles wrong. Also, doesn’t show birth chart information once entered, doesn’t allow for editing if information was incorrectly entered. 

Sent two different messages to the email address (listed as the way to contact them in the bad reviews), but I have yet to get as response. 

Hard to trust a developer that makes it hard to contact them

reviews.title: Why free download
reviews.text: Literally no point in a free download if you can’t open anything after putting all your information in 🙄 you have a better chance of just going online and getting an abundant amount of information. I rather have some free things that make me want to buy rather than downloading an app putting all your info in just to see that you can’t open literally anything.

reviews.title: Totally Disappointed
reviews.text:
I paid for a full year subscription and now the app won’t open!!! it keeps giving me an error message saying I don’t have Internet or that my Internet activity is unstable. However, I have Internet. I’m able to get on the Internet and I have no issues with my Internet in my home. 
PLEASE FIX THE APP OR REFUND MY MONEY!!! 

Thank you for your attention to this matter!

**P.S. I have already emailed you guys and haven’t received a response.

reviews.title: Couldn’t tell ya
reviews.text: Lol I can’t even open the app

reviews.title: app stopped working
reviews.text: I’m a subscriber and I wasn’t able to use the app for months. I can't pass beyond the loading working screen, followed by ‘no internet connection’ which is not true 🤷🏼‍♀️

reviews.title: Stopped working
reviews.text: I used to love this app, but now every time I try to go in and use it there’s always a network error. I’m still being charged though which is crazy. I don’t want to cancel but if this app no longer works I will have no choice but to do so.

reviews.title: Terrible scam
reviews.text:
App stopped working after first use. I found I was charged for three months and then another renewal - all on the same day I signed up for this app. A total of almost $70 illegally— for an app that won’t work. After reading other reviews others have had same issues being constantly charged and not able to use the app. 
I thought I researched enough to know this app was recommended. You can’t even contact them through their own help form which crashes. I had to email them. What a scam.
